design_description: An elegant heritage-inspired design built around a soft white base covered with an ornate tonal floral pattern that gives the jersey a refined, almost royal aesthetic. Deep burgundy and gold trims on the collar and sleeve cuffs add a classic European feel, while the monochromatic crest integration keeps the composition sophisticated and balanced. The subtle damask-style texture creates depth without overpowering the minimalist layout. Overall, the kit feels timeless, premium, and ceremonial — closer to luxury fashion tailoring than a traditional football jersey.
